summary: Demo tenant Console dashboards not populating metrics (empty graphs) in demo project
description:
Issue Summary:
Console dashboards for the demo tenant are showing empty graphs (no cost/latency/error data) for the primary demo project during dry runs and at least one live customer call. This breaks the Observability portion of the standard demo (Console tour).

Impact:
- SEs cannot reliably show token-level cost, latency percentiles, error rates, or rollout dashboards.
- Creates "product looks empty" perception even though the API is working.
- Requires last-minute manual workarounds (running synthetic traffic generator, changing time ranges, switching projects).

Customer / Context:
- Demo tenant used for sales demos (internal), but used in customer-facing calls.
- Reported after a demo runthrough where the API steps succeeded but the Console remained empty.

Environment:
- Demo org + projects in prod control plane (us-east)
- Console: prod
- Telemetry ingestion: prod

Expected Behavior:
- Demo project dashboards show recent traffic (last 15m / last 1h) with realistic distributions.
- Default landing state should not be empty if synthetic traffic is running.

Actual Behavior:
- Console dashboards show empty charts (no data) even after several demo API calls.
- Some views show an "empty state" that does not guide the user to select the correct project/time range.

Steps to Reproduce:
1) Login to Console and switch to Demo Org.
2) Select project "demo-observability" (or the default demo project).
3) Navigate to Dashboards > Latency and Dashboards > Cost.
4) Set time range to "Last 15 minutes".
5) Observe empty graphs.
6) Meanwhile, run a few chat completion requests against the demo route and confirm 200 responses.

Notes / Observations:
- In some cases, switching time range to "Last 24 hours" shows data, suggesting freshness/time-range defaults are a factor.
- When synthetic traffic generator is manually started, data appears after ~5–10 minutes, but this is too brittle for live demos.

Initial Links:
- Slack thread: sources/slack/sales/1741446203.json ("live-demo panic—dashboards are empty")
- Runbook: demo tenant reset + verification checklist (see related confluence pages)

Request:
- Identify whether this is (a) ingestion not receiving events, (b) Console querying wrong project/time range, (c) synthetic traffic job not running, or (d) demo seed config missing required routes/events.
- Provide a fast, reliable pre-demo check + remediation path.
comments: 2025-11-12 - Markus Klein (Reporter): We had the demo API steps working but the Console was empty (cost/latency). This blocks the observability module. We need a deterministic fix; the workaround of "change to last 24h" is not acceptable in a customer call.

2025-11-12 - Allison Grant (Assignee): Taking triage. First hypothesis: synthetic traffic generator job not running (or stuck) so dashboards depend on sparse manual calls. Second hypothesis: Console default filters (project selection/time range) are landing on a project with no telemetry. Pulling telemetry ingestion logs for demo org + checking the demo-traffic job status.

2025-11-12 - Logan Wright: Quick check: ingestion shows *some* events for demo org but mostly in bursts. For the time window 16:00–16:20 PT, demo-observability had <10 requests. That’s not enough to populate certain aggregated views. We should ensure the synthetic generator runs continuously and emits the specific event types Console dashboards expect (request.completed, token.usage, error.*).

2025-11-12 - Chloe Martin: Confirmed Console empty state is confusing: if no project is explicitly selected, some dashboard views render empty without prompting. Also, the default time range is "Last 15m" which can be empty if the synthetic traffic job is paused. I can patch the empty-state to (1) default to the seeded demo project and (2) show a CTA to start synthetic traffic / link runbook.

2025-11-13 - Allison Grant: Found that the demo synthetic traffic generator was not enabled in one of the demo namespaces after a reset. The reset script re-seeded org/projects/routes but did not restart the generator job. Manual remediation: start demo-traffic-generator preset "observability" and wait ~7 minutes; dashboards populate. We need this automated in reset/healthcheck.

2025-11-13 - Sean Gallagher: Adding this as a demo SLO concern (dashboard freshness). Suggest demo healthcheck includes: (a) last_ingested_event_age < 5m for demo-observability project, (b) synthetic generator running, (c) Console can query metrics endpoint successfully. If any fail, return a clear PASS/FAIL with suggested commands.

2025-11-14 - Allison Grant: Implemented immediate workaround in the runbook: after reset, run the synthetic traffic job and verify by checking "Requests" count > 100 in last 15m. Also advising SEs to switch to "Last 1h" if needed while we ship a better default/empty-state.

2025-11-15 - Allison Grant: Resolved by (1) ensuring synthetic traffic generator is started by default for demo tenant and (2) Console empty-state improvements merged. After deploying, dashboards show data in last 15m consistently within 2–3 minutes of reset completion.
investigation_notes: Telemetry: Ingestion pipeline healthy; events present but insufficient volume during certain windows.
Root cause appears to be a reset/seed gap: demo tenant could be reset to a state where traffic generator is stopped/disabled, leaving dashboards reliant on sparse manual demo calls.
Contributing factor: Console empty-state + default time range does not guide users when no data in last 15m and/or when the wrong project is selected.
Verified by starting the generator manually and observing metrics appear within ~5–10 minutes.
resolution:
Resolution:
- Enabled/verified demo synthetic traffic generator preset for the demo-observability project as part of standard reset.
- Updated Console empty-state / default selection behavior so the seeded demo project is easier to land on and empty graphs provide actionable guidance.

Workaround (for field, before full rollout):
1) Run demo-traffic-generator preset "observability".
2) Wait 5–10 minutes.
3) In Console, set time range to Last 1h and confirm request volume > 100.

Validation:
- After reset + generator start, latency/cost/error dashboards populate consistently.
- Manual demo calls alone are no longer required to avoid empty graphs.
follow_ups: Add a demo healthcheck that asserts "dashboard freshness" (last_ingested_event_age) and generator job status; surface as a single PASS/FAIL for SEs.
Update demo tenant reset automation to be fully idempotent for generator job enablement (no manual post-reset steps).
Add alerting on demo dashboards data freshness (e.g., no events for >10m during business hours) routed to demo on-call alias.
Document expected time-to-populate after reset (target: <= 3 minutes) and include in SE checklist.
